newsitem.title: USA: California Senate panel OKs school bond reform.
newsitem.headline: California Senate panel OKs school bond reform.

text.p: A California legislative panel on Wednesday approved a bill that would make it easier for school districts and community colleges to issue general obligation bonds.
The state Senate Education Committee voted 9-to-3 to approve Senate Constitutional Amendment 12, by Senator Jack O'Connell, a Democrat.
If approved by the legislature and the state's voters, the measure would roll back California's restrictive two-thirds voter requirement for bonds issued by school districts and commmunity colleges.
Under O'Connell's measure, local general obligation bond issues for school construction and improvements would require the approval of a simple majority of the voters.
